title: Microsoft Intune (Microsoft Graph v1.0, read-only application permissions)
readScopes: Microsoft Graph application permission DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All (GET /deviceManagement/managedDevices), with admin consent.
Microsoft Graph application permission DeviceManagementConfiguration.Read.All (GET /deviceManagement/deviceCompliancePolicies and its /assignments), with admin consent.

checks.title: An assigned compliance policy requires encryption for each laptop platform in use
checks.scope: Windows (storageRequireEncryption or bitLockerEnabled) and macOS (storageRequireEncryption) compliance policies with at least one assignment, for platforms that have a managed device.

checks.title: An assigned compliance policy requires a password and a lock after at most 15 idle minutes
checks.scope: Windows and macOS compliance policies with an assignment: passwordRequired and passwordMinutesOfInactivityBeforeLock within --intune-max-lock-minutes. Settings delivered by configuration profiles rather than compliance policies are not read.

checks.title: An assigned compliance policy sets a minimum OS version for each laptop platform in use
checks.scope: Windows and macOS compliance policies with an assignment and an osMinimumVersion (at or above --intune-min-os when given).

checks.title: Each managed device is compliant with its Intune compliance policies
checks.scope: Every Intune managed device, one result per device; unknown and configManager states are skipped. A device is only as compliant as the policies assigned to it.

checks.title: Each managed device reports its storage as encrypted
checks.scope: Every Intune managed device, from isEncrypted.

checks.title: Each managed device runs an OS at or above the minimum version
checks.scope: Managed devices whose platform has a minimum from --intune-min-os or from the assigned compliance policies' osMinimumVersion; others are skipped.

checks.title: Each managed device has synced with Intune within the last 14 days
checks.scope: Every Intune managed device, from lastSyncDateTime; the window is --intune-sync-days.
